content.short: Sunterra is an original, voxel-styled, AAA, fantasy-themed, metaverse MMORPG building in the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description:
Sunterra is an original, voxel styled, AAA, fantasy themed, metaverse MMORPG building on the Cardano blockchain. Players will have a variety of play to earn methods at their disposal whilst partaking in a truly addictive and immersive gaming experience.

Such methods include, but are not limited to; The trading of player owned lands which are situated in certain regions on the map, on which experiences can be built. Such experiences may include games, galleries, personal houses or any other forms of property imaginable that can generate revenue, (e.g. The Sandbox.) They can participate in a wide variety of minigames on offer. The most noteworthy being Sunsteal; A public capture-the-flag styled mining/raiding game that constantly rages between the two factions, the 'Aethereals,' and 'Abyssals’. Players receive a distribution for their efforts at the end of every Cardano epoch.

There is also a leveling aspect, where avatars improve various skills through different actions or quests. (e.g. Runescape,) which allows them to gain access to rarer skins, clothing, weapons, armor, and mounts. PVE group or single raids. PVP battles. All items and avatars within the game are tradeable NFT's that can be bought and sold on Radex, our in-game Exchange and NFT marketplace.
